A compound press that builds chest thickness, triceps, and pressing power from a stable bench.

A compound press that builds chest thickness, triceps, and pressing power
from a stable bench.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Lie on the bench with eyes under the bar and feet planted.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Unrack with locked elbows and lower the bar to mid-chest.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Press up in a slight arc until elbows lock without bouncing.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Keep shoulder blades pinched and a natural arch in the back.
